_readme: Approved reader responses. A page shows only the responses listed under its own URL key.
To publish one: add an object to the array for that page. Create the key if it is not here.
Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by the site.

Blank lines inside text start a new paragraph. Use 

 for that.
Nothing else on the site needs changing. Save this file and the page updates in about a minute.
